Source files behind a result

Source: R/outputs-provenance.R
result_provenance.Rd

Looks up the provenance rows, one per source file, for the sittings in x: the file path, its sha256 checksum, the parser generation and when it was parsed. Use it to trace a result back to the exact files it was built from.

Usage

result_provenance(x, columns = NULL, collect = TRUE, limit = NULL)

Arguments

x

A character vector of sitting_ids, or a data frame or lazy table with a character sitting_id column.

columns

Character vector of provenance columns to return; NULL returns all.

collect

If TRUE (the default), return a tibble; if FALSE, a lazy table for further dplyr work.

limit

Maximum number of rows to return, or NULL for no limit.

Value

A tibble with one row per source file and the columns of provenance (path, sha256, schema_generation, parsed_at, input_row_count, output_action_count, sitting_id, source); zero rows if no sitting matches. A lazy table if collect = FALSE.

Details

x is either a character vector of sitting_ids, or any result with a sitting_id column, such as the output of get_speeches() or search_speeches_by_terms(). A result may be a data frame (or tibble) or a lazy table on the package connection, such as one returned with collect = FALSE; a lazy table is matched inside DuckDB, without reading it into R. Each distinct sitting is looked up once, and NA sitting ids in a result are ignored.

A sitting with no provenance row gives no row; it is not an error. Stored values are returned unchanged.

See also

get_provenance() to filter provenance by any column

Examples

db_connect(sample = TRUE)
result_provenance("house_2002-10-15")
#> # A tibble: 1 × 8
#>   path              sha256 schema_generation parsed_at           input_row_count
#>   <chr>             <chr>  <chr>             <dttm>                        <int>
#> 1 ../dataset/zenod… 4d5a0… v2.0              2026-11-23 10:54:42             317
#> # ℹ 3 more variables: output_action_count <int>, sitting_id <chr>, source <chr>
speeches <- get_speeches(from = 2002, to = 2002, include_text = FALSE)
result_provenance(speeches)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 8
#>   path              sha256 schema_generation parsed_at           input_row_count
#>   <chr>             <chr>  <chr>             <dttm>                        <int>
#> 1 ../dataset/zenod… 4d5a0… v2.0              2026-11-23 10:54:42             317
#> 2 ../dataset/zenod… 35654… v2.0              2026-11-23 11:20:21             328
#> # ℹ 3 more variables: output_action_count <int>, sitting_id <chr>, source <chr>
db_disconnect()
